common.comingSoonBody: This area isn't part of this build yet. The navigation, theming, and core peering flows are fully interactive.

landing.badge: Beta · Free for the DN42 community
landing.title: DN42 AutoPeer
landing.subtitle: Free automated BGP peering for DN42. Connect to the network in minutes with zero manual configuration — WireGuard tunnels, multi-node redundancy, instant peering.
landing.nodesSubtitle: Select from multiple geographic locations for optimal latency
landing.perfSubtitle: Recent metrics for each peering node
landing.noNodes: No peering nodes are available right now.

why.zeroConfigBody: No manual BGP or WireGuard setup. Submit your ASN and public key — the platform handles the rest automatically.
why.multiNodeBody: Peer across multiple geographic locations for improved reliability and lower-latency connections.
why.freeBody: Completely free for the DN42 community. No hidden fees, no usage limits, open for everyone.

login.title: Sign in to AutoPeer
login.subtitleAsn: Enter your ASN to authenticate via email, GPG, or passkey.
login.subtitleEmail: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email for AS{asn}.
login.subtitleGpg: Sign the challenge text with your GPG key for AS{asn}.
login.subtitlePasskey: Use your registered passkey for AS{asn}.
login.gpgDetected: GPG key detected in your mntner object
login.gpgEnterAsn: Enter your ASN to check GPG availability
login.gpgUnavailable: No GPG fingerprint found in your mntner object
login.adminLink: Admin? Sign in to the admin panel
login.challengeHint: Copy this text and sign it with your GPG key.
login.passkeyPrompt: Your browser will ask for your passkey.
login.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.

cliActivate.title: Authorize device
cliActivate.subtitle: Confirm the code shown by your device or CLI to grant it access.
cliActivate.approved: Device approved. You can return to your device.
cliActivate.notFound: Device request not found or expired.
cliActivate.signInFirst: Sign in first to authorize a device.

peers.title: My Peers
peers.emptyBody: Create your first peering session to connect your ASN to the DN42 network.

peerNew.title: Create New Peer
peerNew.gateClosedBody: New peering requests are temporarily disabled by the operators. Please check back later.
peerNew.pubkeySupport: Paste the base64-encoded WireGuard public key.
peerNew.endpointSupport: Format host:port. Domains resolve to all A/AAAA records.
peerNew.llaSupport: The peer link-local address, e.g. fe80::1234.
peerNew.pskBody: Adds a symmetric key for an extra layer of encryption. Generated and shown after creation.
peerNew.reviewNote: Deployment is handled automatically. Your peer will be active within minutes after approval.
peerNew.createdBody: Your peer was submitted. Save the pre-shared key now — it won't be shown again.

validation.pubkey: Must be a base64 WireGuard key of at least 40 characters.

guidance.active: The tunnel is established and the BGP session is up.
guidance.pending: This peer is awaiting review. It will be approved shortly.
guidance.suspended: The peer is suspended. Contact the operators to resume it.
guidance.rejected: The peer was rejected. Check the rejection note before retrying.

peerDetail.connParamsSub: Remote details required to establish the tunnel.
peerDetail.nodeConfigSub: Tunnel parameters provided by this node.
peerDetail.notFoundBody: This peer doesn't exist or doesn't belong to your ASN.
peerDetail.deleteBody: This removes the tunnel and the peering session for AS{asn}. This action cannot be undone.

lookingGlass.title: Looking Glass
lookingGlass.subtitle: Run network diagnostics from an AutoPeer node against DN42 or public targets.
lookingGlass.targetSupport: IP address or hostname (DN42 or public).
lookingGlass.empty: Run a query to see results here.

security.title: Security Sessions
security.subtitle: Active devices and tokens authorized for your ASN.
security.revokeBody: The selected device will be signed out immediately.
security.revokeOthersBody: Every session except this one will be signed out.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose which emails and Telegram messages you receive about your peering sessions.
notifications.confirmDisableBody: Disabling this notification may mean you miss important changes. Continue?

telegram.notBoundBody: Link your Telegram account to receive peering notifications in chat.
telegram.notConfigured: Telegram notifications are not configured on this instance.
telegram.linkHint: Open this link in Telegram within 10 minutes to finish linking.

audit.title: Account Audit Log
audit.subtitle: Login events and peering changes related to your ASN.

mcpKeys.title: MCP API Keys
mcpKeys.subtitle: Connect AI assistants to your AutoPeer account via MCP.
mcpKeys.revokeBody: Applications using this key will immediately lose access.
mcpKeys.configBody: Add this to your AI assistant's MCP config. Replace the key with one of your own.
mcpKeys.secretOnce: Copy this key now — it will never be shown again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to that.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.asn_not_found: ASN not found in the DN42 registry.
errors.gpg_not_supported: This ASN has no GPG key registered.
errors.peer_exists: You already have a peer on this node.
errors.too_many_pending: You have too many pending peer requests.
errors.operation_in_progress: Another operation for this peer is in progress.
errors.query_failed: The query failed on the node.
